end.summary: Aditya practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere using toys and objects; some answers were right, but naming was not steady yet.
end.parentNote: Asha practised solids through familiar examples such as a dice, orange, matchbox, cone and glue-stick mark. Aditya identified the orange as a sphere and later changed the idea that every matchbox is a cube; this mix-up was corrected later in the lesson. They are still building how to sort solids by flat and curved faces, so at home, ask them to find one cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere and describe each face.
